## Complex K⁺ (written; not invented)
build_complex(O, loads, "A2_enrich") from /tmp/repo539/docs/S2-11DM2ET-X-Axiomatic-Book/scripts/architecture_A4plus_probe.py, imported read-only. It is the path plus all same-tower edges plus the 2-fill of all triangles in that graph.
Gate (else VOID): V = 539, E = 594, F = 56 (written).
Exact method: ranks of ∂₁ (E × V) and ∂₂ (F × E) with signed (oriented) incidences, over Q (fmpz) and over F_p (nmod). β_k(F_p) from the ranks. Integer torsion at p is detected by rank_p < rank_Q.

## Map-C25 (primary; the 140 split)
Prediction: there exists p ∈ {2, 5, 7} with (β₀, β₁, β₂)(F_p) ≠ (β₀, β₁, β₂)(F_3), while all control primes give the same Betti vector as F_3.
PASS iff both hold.

## Map-C26 (torsion support)
Prediction: H_*(K⁺; Z) has non-trivial torsion, and every torsion prime lies in {2, 5, 7} (among all tested primes).
PASS iff torsion ≠ 0 and its tested support ⊆ {2, 5, 7}.
